Thai Tea
By: Jenny
Published: Sunday, February 14, 2010 - 2:22am

Ingredients




8 cups water
6 tablespoons Thai tea
simple syrup or granulated sugar
ice cubes
half and half, or sweetened condens

Preparation

1 Bring water to boil.  2 Add tea and steep 5 minutes.  3 Strain and season to taste with sugar.  4 Cool, then chill in refrigerator.  5 When ready to serve, place ice cubes in each of 6 tall glasses. Pour tea over ice, leaving room to add half and half to taste.

About


When days are hot, cut the heat with a glass of cold, sweet Thai tea. The distinct orange color comes from the dark red tea leaves. You'll find loose Thai tea or Thai tea powder in most Asian markets and Southeast Asian import shops. 
In Thailand, this tea can be bought on the street and is often poured into a plastic bag for easy carrying.
